description: List this business's services from its extracted catalogue. This is a complete, enumerable list with a total count — unlike `services`, which is a semantic search returning only the closest matches. Use `filter` to narrow by name and `offset` to page.

filter.description: Optional words to narrow the list; case-insensitive. Each word must appear in the name or summary, in any order — so fewer, more distinctive words match more. Omit it to list the whole catalogue.

offset.description: How many to skip. Pass the nextOffset from the previous call to get the next page.

name: list_services
